parameters.content:
## Weekly "what we shipped" digest
Fixed steps, no AI. The input is structured (issue, project, status, date) and the output is a list, so every step is a rule: fetch, group, format, post. A model would add cost and a chance of inventing an item that was never shipped.

Edit only the **Config** node.
